subject: AI/ML Leaders Mixer - 15 May - 25 Lusk SF
text:
Hi [NAME]ël,

Been following your work at Reve since you came out of stealth in March,
saw tons of impressive creations off your model so I wanted to reach out.
Our co-founder [SENDER] is hosting a small social mixer next Thursday, and
we'd love for you to join.

It'll be at 25 Lusk from 6:30-9:30 PM (catered + open bar) for 30
industry innovators, with confirmed attendees from other teams building
content generation models like Black Forest Labs, Genmo, Roblox, etc.

Bit of context on Encord... we're a computer vision development platform.
We help teams building creator tools like Synthesia and Captions better
structure and focus their RLHF / annotation projects.

Would be great to welcome you - let me know if you're around!

subject: [Invite] Encord CV/ML Leaders Dinner - 29 May
text:
Hi [NAME],

Heard great things about your work on model training at Brinc-particularly
as you expand into life-saving use cases. So wanted to invite you to an
intimate dinner our co-founders, [SENDER] & [SENDER], will be hosting for AI
leaders in Seattle - we'd love for you to join if you're interested / can
make it?

We've booked a private dinning room at Aerlume Seattle on Thursday, May
29th, 6:30-9:30 pm, capping attendance at ~30 people. Attendees include
CxOs & technical leaders from leading AI/ML VC-backed scale-ups working
with computer vision - i.e. Skydio, Zipline, Voxel AI.

Bit of context on Encord...we're a computer vision scale-up (recently
raised a $30M Series B) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation,
workflow management and model evaluation under one platform.Let me know if
you're interested/free - happy to send over the full details.

subject: {Invitation}  Encord's AI Leaders Roundtable in Paris
text:
Hi [NAME],​

Our Head of AI will be hosting an intimate dinner with customers & AI leaders and we would like to invite you. 

Attendees range from Directors of Computer Vision & VPs of AI from larger orgs like AXA, Sanofi, etc as well as CEO's & CTO's of leading VC-backed start-ups such as Deepomatic, Scortex, etc

This intimate dinner will take place on 21st of May at the Maison de L'Amérique Latine restaurant where we have secured a private dining room for ~20 people, starting at 7pm. 

In case you're not familiar with Encord, we raised $50M from CRV/YC and are an end-end data development platform for ML teams from Axa, EuroControl, Moon Surgical, etc. We are consolidating data management, visualisation, and annotation, solution all under one platform. 

Please RSVP to this invite should you wish to secure a spot on the dinner, spots are limited and on a first come, first served basis.

Au plaisir,
